source_units.text: Critique the legibility of an imaginary clock design.
Build the piece around these synthetic facts: The imaginary clock uses thin silver hands over a pale dial.
Critique the weak visual contrast and suggest a darker hour hand while preserving the uncluttered face.
The text must contain "thin silver hands", "pale dial", "a darker hour hand" verbatim.
The total word count must fall from 60 to 90, inclusive.
